note: Colours are as drawn in the source figure; recolour by palette role when reusing. The library is a reference, not a limit: draw what the figure needs.

entries.name: bracket-legend-two-cell-titled
entries.depicts: bold title label ('Steering weights') over a horizontal rule divided by vertical tick marks into two named cells (SPF / Dynamic)
entries.notes: dimension-line-style grouping bracket rather than a curly brace; functions as a mini legend key for an edge category
entries.varies: number of cells, cell labels, title text

entries.name: bracket-underline-caption-tick
entries.depicts: plain horizontal bracket line with a short downward centre tick, captioned below with the name of the panel group it spans
entries.notes: minimalist alternative to a curly brace -- just a straight rule with one tick
entries.varies: span width, caption text, tick position

entries.name: dashed-edge-dual-leader-labels
entries.depicts: long dashed curved graph edge with an inline value label ('1'), independently annotated at each end by a plain text term (TE weights / Default) connected via its own short thin leader arrow pointing at the curve
entries.notes: disambiguates which of several similar-looking lines a general term refers to; pairs with the single-label variant (dashed-edge-single-leader-label) from the same figure
entries.variant: plain term connected by a thin leader arrow to one of several similar lines
entries.varies: number of leader labels (1 or 2 ends), label text, curve shape, arrow length/angle

entries.name: dashed-edge-single-leader-label
entries.depicts: dashed curved graph edge dipping below the node row, labelled '1', annotated at its far end by a plain text term (Scavenger) via a short thin leader arrow
entries.notes: single-end variant of dashed-edge-dual-leader-labels from the same figure
entries.variant: plain term connected by a thin leader arrow to one of several similar lines
entries.varies: label text, curve shape/depth, arrow angle

entries.name: offload-curved-arrow-multiline-caption
entries.depicts: thick red curved arrow with a 4-line bold italic red caption describing the data movement it depicts, spanning a long distance across the figure
entries.notes: matches checklist family new:curved-callout-arrow-bold-label (previously black label; here red-on-red, multi-line); a second near-identical instance elsewhere in the figure was skipped as a near-duplicate
entries.variant: thick curved solid-fill arrow pointing at a bold caption
entries.varies: arrow colour, caption length/colour, curve shape and span

entries.name: zoom-callout-dashed-box-captioned
entries.depicts: dashed selection rectangle drawn around one cell of a larger grid, captioned directly below naming what it highlights
entries.notes: the whole dashed rectangle exports as a single compound path (dashes baked into one filled outline), not a stroke-dasharray
entries.varies: box size/aspect, caption text, dash style

entries.name: zoom-callout-diagonal-leader-expansion
entries.depicts: two diagonal leader lines expanding from a small box above down into a wider full-width inset row below, showing a 3-step labelled arrow chain (...->'Propagate trace_id'->'Request r2')
entries.notes: 238pt long-side warning is the expected whole-figure-width exception (the expansion legitimately spans the full figure); the endpoint captions 'Received Request r1' and 'Triggered Request r2' text elements were not included (could not be isolated cleanly in the time available), so the left/right ends of the row show only their connecting arrows -- still clearly reads as a zoom expansion
entries.varies: span width, number of steps in the expanded row, leader angle

entries.name: brace-bundle-labelled-data
entries.depicts: a large curly brace grouping a bundle of parallel signal lines, labelled at its point and followed by an ellipsis for elided lines
entries.varies: label text; brace size; ellipsis presence

entries.name: measurement-gate-with-error-tick
entries.depicts: a square measurement-meter gate glyph with a short dashed vertical tick topped by an exclamation mark, marking an injected error just before it on the wire
entries.notes: new family: a compact inline defect/error marker on a wire or timeline, distinct from check-cross (which marks a whole element, not a point on a line)
entries.variant: dashed tick topped by an exclamation mark on a wire or timeline
entries.varies: tick colour/dash style; gate type marked; mark glyph (! vs other)

entries.name: acc-digit-list-highlight
entries.depicts: rounded ACC (accumulator) box with an output arrow into a run of plain digits, one digit highlighted in red
entries.notes: clean; pairs with value-selector-hex-dial as two different visualisations of the same accumulate-and-select idiom
entries.varies: digit run, which digit is highlighted

entries.name: autoregressive-token-feedback-loop-step
entries.depicts: one previous-output token box feeds a big smooth curved arc back up into the next step's dashed-border input box; the input flows down through a small compute cell and up into a new solid output box
entries.notes: new family: the canonical LLM autoregressive-decoding feedback arc, distinct from the right-angle new:orthogonal-feedback-loop; four such steps chain across the source figure, only one cut
entries.variant: smooth curved arc feeding the previous output token back into the next step
entries.varies: arc span/shape; box labels; solid vs dashed styling

entries.name: bar-split-insertion-marker-callout
entries.depicts: a thin vertical white rounded divider inserted into a horizontal process bar, marking where it was split into two stages, named by an italic red leader-line callout ('Scheduling site')
entries.variant: thin divider marking where a process bar was split
entries.varies: divider position/style; callout text/colour

entries.name: bus-merge-tree-branch
entries.depicts: an orthogonal bus-tree branching down from a single shared connector to several source arrowheads, with a label at the trunk
entries.notes: orthogonal-routed variant of pilot family new:hub-leaf-fan-node
entries.varies: branch count/spacing; label text

entries.name: capsule-bar-operator-circle-count
entries.depicts: a wide colour rounded capsule bar labelled with an id, a small operator-circle glyph, and a xN replica count
entries.notes: glyph-size atom of the same idiom as the wider Gantt-style task blocks in this figure
entries.varies: colour, id number, count, bar width/length
